title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E30 — Country Club Munsters
Herman is convinced that a television competition is fixed, until he wins free membership at an exclusive country club.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E31 — Love Comes to Mockingbird Heights
Marilyn decides to elope with a bank employee who is interested in the Munsters' money.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E32 — Mummy Munster
Herman is mistaken for a perfectly preserved mummy.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E33 — Lily Munster, Girl Model
Lily works as a model.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E34 — Munster the Magnificent
Eddie volunteers to have Herman perform in a school talent show.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E35 — Herman's Happy Valley
Herman buys a piece of land as a vacation home for the family, which he discovers in a prospectus; the fraudsters who originally sold the property have received a better offer and want it back.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E36 — Hot Rod Herman
Herman drag-races in the family hearse to back up Eddie's boast that his dad is a better driver than his friend's father.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E37 — Herman's Raise
When Herman is forced to work overtime at the parlor, Lily grows furious and convinces him that he deserves a raise; he is fired when he demands an increase in pay.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E38 — Yes, Galen, There Is a Herman
Herman rescues a little boy whose head is trapped in the park railings, but doesn't get all the credit he deserves; Herman strikes up a friendship with the youngster.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E13 — Underground Munster
Herman causes a major crisis when he chastises Spot for tracking mud into the house.

title: The Munsters
description:
S2 E1 — Herman's Child Psychology
Eddie runs away when one of his friends convinces him that all parents are mean.

title: The Forest
description:
S1
While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.

title: Games
description:
S1
A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.

title: Gone
description:
S1
A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

title: The Green Inferno
description:
S1
Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.

title: The Guardian
description:
S1
Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.

title: I Saw What You Did
description:
S1
Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.

title: Incarnate
description:
S1
Recruited by a Vatican emissary (Catalina Sandino Moreno), an exorcist (Aaron Eckhart) taps into the subconscious mind of a tormented boy (David Mazouz) to free him from demonic possession.
